notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש em i 'breath/warapela laip bilong man', i no 'soul' — Tok Pisin 'bel bilong mi' i klostu

notes.subject: baim bek
notes.rationale: פדה em i 'baim bek, rausim long paterol bilong narapela'

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: אשר (we, olsem) — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela stret tok, mi bin putim 'em'

notes.subject: שפתי/אזמרה
notes.rationale: Tut bilong man i singaut, na em yet i singim singsing — wanpela voice i wok long tupela pasin

translation: Bai tut bilong mi singaut olgeta long amamas, bilong mi singim singsing long yu, na bel bilong mi — ⟨em⟩ ol i bin baim bek long yu.

tokens.gloss: ol i bin baim bek long yu
